payload.title: IPC audit action source omits reopening a saved audit
payload.actual: The bundle names only POST /infection/audits as the audit_id source. IPC can reopen its previously saved synthetic audit from the listed GET /infection/audits; each register row carries audit_id. The API also accepted assigning the new audit's follow-up immediately after creation.
payload.expected: Add GET /infection/audits -> audits[].audit_id to id_sources for the audit action path, so following up an existing finding does not require recording a second audit.
payload.evidence: GET /infection/audits demo.ipc 200 request 8d35a4496ef54c5bbf512f8915fabee5, synthetic IPA-2026-0001 audit_id 1. The original UI assignment was 201 request fa82c47115964fb18ce8ab29d8a56a5e. The register audit ID and the original write response agreed.
